question: In MS Word 2019, which of the following features can you use to change the page orientation of your document?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Page Layout → Orientation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change the page orientation in MS Word 2019, navigate to the **"Page Layout" tab**, then click on **"Orientation."**
 
• There are two orientation options available: **Portrait** (vertical layout) and **Landscape** (horizontal layout).
 
• The "Page Layout → Orientation" feature applies the selected orientation to the entire document or specific sections when used with page breaks.
 
• This feature is essential for formatting documents with varying layout requirements, such as presentations or tables.
 
• MS Word 2019 allows users to preview orientation changes instantly, ensuring accurate formatting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Page Layout Tab:**

 
 
• The "Page Layout" tab provides tools for adjusting document margins, page size, orientation, and column settings.
 
• It also includes options for adding borders, watermarks, and page colors.
 
 
 
• **Portrait vs. Landscape Orientation:**
 
 
• **Portrait:** The default orientation with the height greater than the width, suitable for textual documents.
 
• **Landscape:** An orientation where the width is greater than the height, ideal for tables, charts, or wide content.
 
 
 
• **Section Breaks:**
 
 
• Section breaks allow users to apply different page layouts within the same document.
 
• This feature is useful for combining portrait and landscape pages in one file.
 
 
 
• **Print Layout View:**
 
 
• Print Layout View in MS Word shows how the document will appear when printed, including page orientation changes.
 
• This view is ideal for checking formatting and design before finalizing documents.
